open.title: The recruiting pitch
open.body: One choice shapes the class that signs in two days. A class matters for four years: the roster is the last four classes.

options.label: Sign a safe class
options.detail: The class the programme has earned, no better and no worse.

options.label: Chase a star
options.detail: 38 in 100 that the star signs and the class is 10 points better. Otherwise the class is 5 points worse.

open.title: The clubs ask for the main quad
open.body: A new semester, and forty clubs want the main quad for a fair. Thirty-nine have filled in the form. The juggling club has sent a diagram.

options.label: Give them the quad: $46,000 for tables
options.detail: Happiness is 1 point higher for three days.

open.title: A night watch for the week
open.body: 47 incidents lately had nobody come: a stubbed toe here, a borrowed traffic cone there. Students ask for someone, anyone, with a torch.

options.label: Hire a night watch: $184,000
options.detail: Happiness is 1 point higher for five days. Campus Safety and a Medical Center in reach of the dorms would answer every call.

open.title: The spring concert
open.body: The student committee has two plans for the spring concert and a strong feeling about each.

options.label: Book a touring act: $368,000
options.detail: Happiness is 2 points higher for two days, and one in a hundred more applicants for four days.

options.label: Book three local bands: $92,000
options.detail: Happiness is 1 point higher for two days.

options.label: Let the committee book whoever is free
options.detail: Nothing changes. Someone plays. It is fine.
